svg.text: as_a_operand: the same 32 registers, read as an A operand
Following thread 0 (warp 0, lane 0). Numbers are register indices. Blue: tiles n = 0, 2, 4, 6. Orange: tiles n = 1, 3, 5, 7.
What thread 0 holds of P (64 × 64). Only rows 0 and 8 shown: the other rows belong to other threads.
As the accumulator of S = Q Kᵀ: 8 tiles of 16 × 8, 4 values each
As the A operand of O += P V: 4 tiles of 16 × 16, 8 values each. Same registers, same places: only the grouping differs.
The input: P in the accumulator layout

svg.text: logical_divide cuts a layout into (piece, rest). The
second argument has one entry per mode: None leaves modes
0 and 1 alone, 2 cuts mode 2 into pieces of 2 tiles.
So the 8 tiles become 4 pairs of 2: (2, 4) : (4, 8). The
inner 2 picks a tile within the pair, the outer 4 picks
layout changes: no register is read or written.
Move the pair index into the value mode, on the same registers
